sources.entry: BeatMV - AI music video generator that turns any song into a music video that moves with the beat. #freemium

summary.name: BeatMV
summary.one_liner: BeatMV is an AI music video generator that turns a song (MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, or a Suno/Udio link) into a beat-synced video with AI-directed scenes, up to 8 minutes long.
use_cases: Making a music video for a new song release
Creating TikTok, Reels or YouTube Shorts from a track
Turning a Suno or Udio song into a video
Building a Spotify Canvas loop from a video
Storyboarding a music video before generating it
summary.what_it_does: BeatMV analyzes an uploaded audio file or linked track to detect BPM, beats, drops and song sections, then maps cuts and transitions to the rhythm. It writes a scene-by-scene script and a storyboard grid that users can review and edit before video renders. Users can override shot type, camera movement, style, and the AI model per scene, and regenerate single shots. Reference photos can lock a character's look across scenes. Export offers 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 aspect ratios in HD, with optional karaoke-style lyric overlays.
notable: Storyboard grid and script reviewed before any video renders, with per-shot regeneration
Beat and section detection drives cut timing across full songs up to 8 minutes
Character and location references kept consistent across scenes
Accepts Suno, Udio, YouTube, SoundCloud, TikTok, Spotify links or MP3/WAV/FLAC/M4A uploads
caveats: Page says free starter credits are given on sign-up, and that upgrading is needed for more; paid tier details are not listed on the page
Video generation consumes credits; cost is estimated per length before rendering
Page does not state specific output limits on the free tier
